runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0fc9105c4ffeW0GgOWh2or32hg] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC) from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`:

Each row shows per-slot: **slot number**, **block root**, **first_seen_ms** (earliest node to see the block after slot start), **avg_arrival_ms**, **last_seen_ms**, and **nodes_observed**.

Highlights from the results:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Slot range | ~14,590,799 – ~14,597,998 |
| Fastest first-seen | **215 ms** (slot 14,591,516) and **224 ms** (slot 14,597,752) |
| Slowest first-seen | ~3,725 ms (slot 14,597,760) |
| Typical first-seen (median) | ~1,200–1,600 ms |
| Nodes observing each block | ~154–157 per block |

The full dataset (57452 lines) was saved to `/tmp/panda-opencode-53i03g1g/share/opencode/tool-output/tool_f036f4624001E5ltFrEtlz3G8L`.
